text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to watch because I heard Mejiro 
McQueen was participating in an event at 
the Fan Appreciation Festival, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“—Wildly popular! 'What's Inside the 
Box?!' Our next challenger is... this one 
right hereee!!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Greetings, everyone. Good day to you all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The young lady of the Mejiro family, 
Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tons of folks said, "I wanna see her 
rich-girl reaction!" Can ya live up to 
their hype, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all. No matter what comes, I 
shall simply handle it calmly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Guh...! Even if the fans voted for me, 
why did it have to be for such a baffling 
event!?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(There must be plenty of far more 
respectable events than thissss...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright, let's do this!! Bring out the 
boooox!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, honestly...! At this point, bring on 
whatever you've got...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eek, so cold...!! What in the world is 
this!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A living creature?! Surely it couldn't be 
a living creature...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a short while, Mejiro McQueen 
continued her solitary struggle, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I really can't do this~~...!! Even if 
everyone did vote for me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Anything but this...!! Please, spare me 
from just this~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, what a helpless young lady. 
Getting terrified by konnyaku of all 
things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh... Konjac?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, gotta say, it was quite a sight. 
Watching a fine lady get danced around by 
a piece of konnyaku.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thanks for watching, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: K-Konjac...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think I was getting so flustered... all 
by myself, over a piece of konjac...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That night, Mejiro McQueen apparently had 
a dream where she was chased by a giant 
konjac.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: "It's okay! Nothing to be scared of!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Hang in there, McQueen!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: E-Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(That is quite true... since everyone has 
taken the time to watch, after all!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot allow myself to show such a 
pathetic display...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ngggh—take that!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: O-Oh my...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Could it be... konjac?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! BINGO! Not bad at all, milady!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whew, thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how was it? Wasn't it simply 
magnificent?
choice_data_list: You really know your konnyaku, huh
You really know your konnyaku, don't you

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. At first I thought it was a living 
creature and was frightened, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I could hear the reassuring cheers of the 
fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once I took the leap and reached out to 
grab it myself, it was surprisingly 
simple.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Facing challenges without fear is what 
opens up the future; I feel as though I 
have been reminded of this once again.
choice_data_list: We really owe everyone our thanks.
We really owe everyone our thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. I am truly grateful to 
everyone who always supports me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That night, Mejiro McQueen apparently ate 
konjac dishes while giving thanks to her 
fans.
